notes: `אֲשֶׁר ... בְּלִבָּם` → *whose hearts*: the relative and its resumptive possessive suffix share one unit headed on the relative (rule 22); the suffix's plural agreement is construed ad sensum with the collective `חַיִל`, and reference decides.
The `בְּ` is `unrepresented`: the ASV promotes its object to the direct object of *touched* (rule 40).
